name: guizang-social-card-skill
title_zh: 照片多到选不出就让它自己拼三张动图卡
tagline_zh: 歸藏风格社交卡片全家桶：小红书轮播、微信 21:9+1:1 封面对、Live Photo 动卡，28 版式 10 主题。
tagline_en: Guizang-style social cards — XHS carousels, WeChat cover pairs, Live Photo motion cards; 28 layouts, 10 themes.
desc_en: Generate Guizang-style social card image sets, Live Photo motion cards, material-first Live Photo puzzle layouts, triple Live Photo collages, long-video-to-Live-Photo treatments, and WeChat official account cover pairs from articles, scripts, screenshots, product notes, subtitles, photos, or user-supplied videos. Use when the user asks for 小红书图文, Rednote/Xiaohongshu images, social cards, carousel
why_zh: 歸藏是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，这套编辑部×瑞士风的版式体系就是他的招牌。
why_en: Guizang is a top Chinese AI-design creator; this editorial-Swiss layout system is his signature.
limit_zh: 出图靠本机浏览器截图，核查跑 node validate-social-deck.mjs。实况卡要 makelive 打成 .pvt 再 AirDrop 到 iPhone 发，桌面端认不出。OOTD 全身、美食大片、Y2K 风明说不接。
limit_en: Rendering needs a local browser screenshot pass plus node validate-social-deck.mjs. Live Photo cards must be packed into .pvt with makelive and AirDropped to an iPhone; desktop upload can't publish. OOTD and food-styling posts are refused.
title_en: Auto-compose 3-shot Live Photo cards from your pile
cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/op7418/guizang-social-card-skill; 按 references/production-workflow.md 在 local-tests/swiss-three-rules/index.html 用 assets/template-swiss-card`。我造的 demo（卡片上的文字是我写的，内容取自这件 skill 自己 references/style-system.md 里的硬规则，不是编的）
